1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Aadhar Card, PAN Card, GST Registration Copy must be uploaded in the bid. (Bidder must have an office in Gujarat, Branch office not allowed) 2. MSME Certificate, Bank EFT Mandate Form along with Cancelled Cheque will have to be submitted. 3. Non-Black Listed Certificate (Notarized along with a guarantee form on stamp paper of Rs. 100). 4. CA Turnover Certificate, Net Worth Certificate will have to be submitted in the bid. 5. The bidder will have to produce a Bank Solvency Certificate of Rs. 10,00,000. (Should not be older than one year.) 6. The bidder company participating in the bid must have ISO Certificate 9001:2015, 14001:2015 and 1864 4:2016. 7. The product specification sheet approved by the higher authority attached to the bid must be uploaded. 8. The bidder must attach the latest certificate of GSTR1/GSTR 3B or CMP-8 / GSTR 4. Duct specification sh eet must be uploaded. 9. The bidder will have to submit ITR returns for the last 3 years 10. The bidder participating in the bid must have three years (financial/calendar) experience in the Gujarat Forest Department and any Government/Semi-Government Department. 11. Bidder must submit a valid lab test report from a government laboratory for all products. 12. The latest menu of the product supplied by the L-1 bidder should be fabricated and its validity should be at least one year. 13. All powers to approve or reject any offer shall be reserved to the concerned Purchase Committee. No r eason shall be given for their approval or rejection. 14. The deductions prescribed by the Government on the bill presented for payment by the bidder such as TDS/GST will be deducted by this office as per the rules which will be binding on the bidder himself. 15. The bidder participating in the bid must meet the quality as mentioned in the Additional Specification Parameters, Additional ATC of the product mentioned in the bid and must fill the prices accordingly in the b id. 16. The prices offered will be inclusive of GST and all applicable current government taxes as well as the q uantity determined by the office upon reaching the place and transportation loading-unloading. 17. The legal jurisdiction for any dispute relating to the bid shall remain Pending. 18. The specifications, details, conditions and bids mentioned in the bid must be guaranteed in writing. All documents must be signed and stamped and scanned copies must be uploaded in the bid. 19. The bidder declared L-1 shall deliver the quantity and packing size as per the requirement of the office

throughout the year as per the contract to the place specified/specified by the office. The bill of the quantit y sent as per the requirement of the said office shall be submitted by this office. 20. OEM Turnover of last three years must be submitted for all products. 21. The approved prices of the said bid shall be valid for one year from the date of contract and if deemed necessary, the said contract shall be valid for the remaining period of the contract as per the terms of the contract (whichever is higher) until the repurchase process is carried out with the mutual consent of the He ad of the Purchasing Office and the L-1 declared bidder. 22. In case any dispute arises before/after the approval of the prices, the decision of the concerned Purcha se Committee shall be final and binding on the concerned. 23. If the office asks for original legal documents for verification of the documents submitted with the bid, the bidder will have to submit them. 24. Bidders will have to offer the prices of the products mentioned in the bid. 25. The goods supplied by the L-1 bidder should be of good quality. 26. The decision of the Purchase Committee regarding all the above conditions shall be final and binding. 27. OEM Authorisation for all products, copy must be submitted by the bidder. 28. The bidder must have OEM report & same must be attached at the time of bidding 29. The Bidder must have the experience copy of similar items. 30. L1 bidders’ material will go for the final testing the lab as per shared sample. If the product will valid th en only your payment will be released. 31. The Non-Blacklisting Declaration should be submitted on appropriate non-judicial stamp paper after th e tender is published date, if specifically required as per the tender terms and conditions. 32. Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of DY conservator of forest sabarkantha Himatnagar payable at Himatnagar 30000. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with .
